uncertain.access: Vendor pages contradict each other: pricing page shows Free (3 audits lifetime), Credit Pack 100 $99, Unlimited $299/mo; developers page lists Developer $99/mo through Scale $4,999/mo; mcp.json says 3 free calls per IP per month with keys optional; docs/mcp-server says 10 free audits/day per API key. Whether a free account can mint an ipx_ key could not be confirmed without signing up. Labeled paid_plan_required because API plans start at $99/mo.
uncertain.main_blocker: Both narrow_api (3-4 endpoints, single FX-audit use case) and paid_plan apply; narrow_api chosen.
uncertain.api_breadth: Endpoint lists differ by page: OpenAPI has /fx-audit-engine, /fetch-spot-rate, /roi-calculator; docs/api lists POST /audit, GET /rates, POST /audit/document. Narrow either way.

notes: The hint URL ipayx.ai/docs returns a 404 page; docs live at /docs/api and /docs/mcp-server, plus llms.txt and /.well-known/openapi.json and mcp.json. Not the 2017 iPayX acquired by BillingTree; this is 'iPayX Protocol' (11850091 Canada Inc.), a FINTRAC-registered FX audit service. Live probe of https://mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp returned tools/list without auth (serverInfo 'iPayX FX Audit' v1.4.0). REST server in OpenAPI is a supabase.co Edge Functions URL; api.ipayx.ai custom domain 'coming soon' per developers page. MCP endpoint also differs by page (mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp vs supabase functions/v1/mcp-server).
